subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw accept the generic gateway account-scoped reload contract and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Automation can verify the current bug shape, but choosing the permanent reload contract and replacing the older conflicting PR is an owner-level product and upgrade-safety decision.

options.title: Review and land the newer generic PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical implementation because it is mergeable, proof-positive, and covers the account-scoped reload contract broadly.

options.title: Revive the original narrow PR
options.body: Ask the author of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43938 to resolve conflicts and add real behavior proof, accepting the extra review delay.

options.title: Reject account-scoped reload for now
options.body: Keep whole-channel restarts as the product contract and close the implementation PRs with a clear alternative for draining or retrying in-flight delivery.

recommendation.title: Review and land the newer generic PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical implementation because it is mergeable, proof-positive, and covers the account-scoped reload contract broadly.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the latest current-main refactor of the affected gateway reload files and is already tied to the current implementation history.
